At Apple, we believe the people who build our products deserve systems built with that same care. That belief is what drives People Systems. Behind every revolutionary hardware launch, breakthrough service, and magical customer experience are the passionate people who make it all possible.
This is our pursuit: to be the unseen force behind a world-class employee experience for the most exceptional people on Earth — realized through obsessively crafting and caring for the systems that hire, reward, and support our talent as they grow, thrive, and do the best work of their lives.
Sitting at the vibrant intersection of technology, people, and business, we architect the platforms behind every stage of that journey: Recruiting, Onboarding, Core HR, Payroll, Compensation, and Benefits. Our systems don’t just process transactions; they shape how people experience working here.
When you engineer for People Systems, your users are Apple’s most vital asset: its People. We are seeking a visionary Application Architect to shape the technical strategy for People Systems with a passion for platforms where configuration is the product, and agentic workflows that redefine what's possible..
You will be working on a Platform that helps define features. Data models, rules, workflows, permissions, screens and reports are all versioned configuration, interpreted at runtime, so the people closest to a problem can change how the system behaves without waiting for a release. Hundreds of components must behave as one system. We are looking for an Application Architect who can make that true.
We value engineers who bring both technical excellence and product thinking. You'll make the architectural calls that balance fast delivery against long-term platform health, and build systems that are scalable, secure and resilient by design rather than by retrofit. This role requires someone who thrives on complexity but ships simplicity.
Collaboration is central to how we work. You’ll partner with product managers and cross-functional engineering teams to understand problems deeply before reaching for solutions. The best engineers here are the ones who ask “why” before “how". If you care deeply about precision, data integrity, and crafting platforms where scale meets human empathy, come join us to do the best work of your life.
Architect applications configuration-first: decide what belongs in versioned configuration versus code, keep both on one coherent model, and feed platform gaps back to the platform teams as concrete requirements
Move fluently between components of very different character, from compiled kernels where correctness is absolute to search, UI and AI services where scale, latency and non-determinism dominate, and choose the patterns and guarantees that fit each
Set the core application patterns: one canonical document model, saga-based orchestration, and a hard line between recorded facts and the decisions made about them
Guarantee data integrity, consistency and privacy in high-stakes domains where decisions affect people's careers, enforced where data is read and written so that unsafe access is inexpressible rather than left to caller discipline
Own end-to-end system design for new business initiatives, starting with a systems impact analysis across the existing platform ecosystem
Design APIs with strong contracts and clear versioning, so dozens of consuming teams can build confidently without coordination overhead
Lead the design and coding of modular, domain-driven services on Java / Kotlin, Spring Boot and cloud-native infrastructure, and the event streams that carry complex, high-concurrency workloads; set the testing strategy and hold the bar in code review
Bring an AI-native SDLC and agent orchestration to platform engineering: shape how agents are specified, composed, evaluated, sandboxed and promoted, both in how we build the platform and where agents act inside applications, with tool interfaces over platform APIs, validated structured output and deterministic fallbacks
Define and uphold reliability: SLOs, observability, incident response and zero-downtime deployments; diagnose the hardest distributed-systems failures and tune high-volume batch and real-time pipelines
Establish architecture standards, reference designs and platform blueprints for teams to adopt, and be the go-to technical authority guiding partner teams as they design against and integrate with our platforms
Bring clarity to ambiguous problems and drive decisions that balance innovation, scalability, reliability and compliance; present technical strategy, modernization options, capacity, risk and technical-debt retirement to leadership
Mentor and elevate engineers across teams, so the organisation's technical capacity grows beyond any one person's contribution
Automation Development: Design and build tools to streamline database management tasks and performance tuning. Integrate AI/ML capabilities into areas like intelligent configuration recommendations, workload-aware scheduling, and LLM-powered interfaces that simplify complex operator workflows
API-Driven Services: Design, build, and maintain secure, versioned microservices that expose database lifecycle operations as APIs. Ensure correctness under concurrent execution, handle partial failures gracefully, and evolve the API surface to support new capabilities without breaking existing consumers
Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Integrate database management automation into CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, canary rollouts, and rollback capabilities
Monitoring and Alerting: Develop and enhance monitoring, alerting, and health-check systems that give both the platform team and customers deep visibility into database health. Build self-healing mechanisms that detect and remediate known failure patterns automatically
Minimum Qualifications
15+ years of professional software engineering in system design, technical architecture or solution architecture for large-scale enterprise solutions; BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Led the architecture of a configuration-driven platform used by multiple engineering teams: metadata models, multi-tenancy, extensibility, versioned APIs, and safe publish, promote and rollback of configuration
Proficient across technology stacks rather than tied to one: has built components of very different character in one system (interpreters or compilers of declarative input, query and authorization layers, workflow and state engines, search and reporting, UI runtimes), picking up whatever language, framework or datastore each demands, with the judgement to apply the right guarantees to each
Distributed-systems depth: consistency models, fault tolerance, partitioning and failure-mode analysis; designed for high availability and horizontal scale under variable load, serving millions of users and high-volume transactions
Strong foundation in event-driven and event-sourced architecture: saga and workflow orchestration, streaming platforms, change data capture and transactional data stores
Evolved schemas and contracts at scale: backward-compatible change of metadata and configuration models, breaking-change detection, and migration of in-flight data and workflows
Deep proficiency in Spring Boot (or equivalent) and microservices patterns, with async fluency: virtual threads (Java 21+), coroutines or reactive programming
Expert use of relational or NoSQL databases at scale: schema design, query optimization, migrations and transaction management
Hands-on experience with an AI-native SDLC and agent orchestration frameworks: working with coding agents under tests and review, and building with tool calling, graph-based orchestration, context management and structured-output validation
Cloud-native production experience on AWS or comparable platforms (Kubernetes, identity and access management, cost governance), operating with monitoring, alerting, incident response and a post-mortem culture
Set technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority: break down ambiguous problems without detailed specs, translate business requirements into designs, and explain trade-offs clearly to engineers and executives
Preferred Qualifications
Built expression languages, rule engines or policy engines (typed ASTs, multiple execution backends), and the differential and conformance testing that keeps those backends consistent
Experience decomposing or extending monolithic enterprise systems into service-based platforms that interoperate with the existing system of record while the business ran uninterrupted
Background in CQRS, event sourcing or saga-based orchestration for long-running workflows
Familiarity with compliance and audit requirements for sensitive personal data (PII, regulated HR data), and AI governance: drift detection, bias monitoring, explainability and audit trails
Experience putting LLMs and ML into production backend services: inference APIs, RAG pipelines, vector search, embeddings, evaluation and observability tooling, prompt and context engineering
Proven record of leading technical decisions cross-functionally, aligning non-engineering stakeholders on trade-offs, and moving engineering culture toward measurable reliability, correctness, cost ownership and evaluation-driven development
Designed APIs consumed by many teams (versioning, contract stability, documentation) and integrated with enterprise platforms through APIs, ETL or event streams amid many upstream and downstream dependencies
Developer experience for platform consumers: SDKs, local test harnesses, simulation environments and self-service onboarding
Fluency with AI-assisted development tools, and AI-augmented operations such as predictive alerting, automated root-cause analysis and self-healing runbooks
Designed evaluation, guardrail and human-in-the-loop strategies for AI systems that make or inform consequential decisions
Hands-on chaos engineering and advanced reliability practice: failure injection, game days, capacity modeling and traffic shaping

Would you like to contribute to Machine Learning and Generative AI technologies? Are you passionate about the integrity of the data that powers AI systems at scale? Do you believe that trustworthy data is the foundation of every great model? We truly believe it is!
We are defining what exceptional data quality looks like for machine learning across Wallet, Payments, and Commerce. As a Machine Learning Engineer, AI/ML Model Quality, you will build and maintain intelligent systems, validation frameworks, synthetic data generation models and monitoring pipelines that keep our data ecosystem healthy — ensuring that every model we build is trained, evaluated, and deployed on data we can trust. Your work sits at the foundation of every ML feature that reaches hundreds of millions of users.
You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, statistical rigor and production systems, collaborating closely with Data Engineering, Privacy, and Legal teams. This unique opportunity puts you at the center of ML and AI quality — owning the health of training and validation datasets, defining and analyzing observability metrics, building models to calibrate & measure robustness, and leading telemetry analysis across GenAI workflows — ensuring Apple's financial features are built on the highest-quality data, whether powering conventional ML models or the latest generative AI systems.
The ideal candidate is detail-obsessed who understands that model quality starts long before training — it starts with the data. You have strong statistical instincts, know how silent degradation and data drift manifest in production systems, and can translate raw quality signals into insights that drive real decisions.
You will own the health of the data ecosystem that underpins ML and GenAI features across Wallet, Payments, and Commerce — building validation frameworks, defining observability metrics, and leading telemetry analysis that keeps every model trained, evaluated, and monitored on data teams can trust. Your work sits at the foundation of every ML feature that reaches hundreds of millions of users.
Curate, analyze, and maintain gold-standard ground-truth datasets for model evaluation and continuous validation across both ML and GenAI systems.
Audit training data for systemic bias and fairness gaps prior to model deployment; establish ongoing analytical checks to catch bias introduced by data drift over time.
Define and analyze telemetry across GenAI workflows, tracking quality signals such as output coherence, latency, task completion rates, and regression patterns.
Design mechanisms to detect degradation of models in production in a privacy preserving manner.
Define and own ML observability metrics — model performance, output distributions, training-serving skew, silent degradation and feature drift — translating raw production signals into actionable insights for engineering and product teams.
Design and develop observability dashboards and reporting workflows that give stakeholders a consistent, real-time view of model health across both conventional ML and GenAI systems.
Identify degradation patterns and domain-specific failure modes in GenAI systems through systematic telemetry analysis, translating findings into concrete recommendations for model and data teams.
Define, track, and report key data quality metrics — completeness, accuracy, timeliness, validity for engineering and leadership audiences.
Minimum Qualifications
A Bachelor's degree with exceptional hands-on experience in ML/AI model quality or applied research or a M.S or Ph.D in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
3+ years of experience in defining and tracking ML model health metrics in production — model performance monitoring, feature drift detection, and observability instrumentation.
3+ years of experience in Machine Learning, data science or a closely related analytical role, with a strong focus on data quality, model evaluation, or ML observability in production environments.
Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), common ML frameworks like PyTorch and SQL for complex data analysis, metric creation, and validation.
Experience querying and analyzing large-scale datasets using distributed computing frameworks (e.g., PySpark, Spark, or distributed SQL).
Solid understanding of statistical methods — hypothesis testing, distribution analysis, data drift detection, and statistical process control.
Experience with GenAI or LLM systems, including common quality failure modes, output evaluation approaches, and telemetry instrumentation.
Strong communication skills — ability to translate complex data quality findings and model health risks into clear, actionable insights for both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools (e.g., Tableau, Apache Superset, Databricks) to present complex ML telemetry.
Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g. LangSmith) or techniques like LLM-as-a-judge.
Experience with Bayesian or causal graph-based approaches to synthetic data generation.
Familiarity with confidence calibration techniques and uncertainty quantification.
Experience with ML monitoring or observability platforms (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases, or equivalent).
Experience working with privacy-constrained data or under regulatory compliance frameworks (GDPR, DMA).
Background in financial services, fintech, or consumer payment products.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced machine learning engineer to join AIML Evaluation to build the systems that evaluate and refine Apple's foundation models and agents.
As a key member of the team, you will help design and develop benchmarks, evaluators, simulation environments, and prompt and context optimization pipelines that drive quality improvements across Apple's AI experiences.
You will collaborate with product teams and the foundation model team to close the loop between observation and improvement, contributing datasets, environments, and reward signals that drive model and agent quality.
Most model evaluation stops at a scorecard. The failing traces get thrown away, even though they're the most relevant training signal we have. Our team puts them to work. We evaluate across offline benchmarks, device-in-the-loop simulation, and on-device observation in production, and we turn what we find into persona-grounded datasets and reward signals for foundation model post-training.
In this role, you will build the systems that connect failure analysis to measurable model and agent improvements across a broad range of AI products at Apple. The path from finding a problem to fixing it is short: the loop you build finds the failure, produces the data and checks the result. The work reaches millions of users.
Designing and building evaluation infrastructure for agents and foundation models.
Setting technical direction for the evaluation system and bringing partner teams along.
Developing LLM judges, reward models calibrated against human feedback.
Developing prompt and context optimization pipelines.
Building and integrating simulation environments for agent evaluation and trajectory-based data generation.
Working with product and research teams to identify, prioritize, and address quality gaps.
Building shared foundations such as run lineage, a run registry, and MCP interfaces for client teams' agents.
Minimum Qualifications
Strong background in machine learning and distributed systems.
A proven track record of solving ambiguous problems end to end: defining the problem and the metric, building the solution, and showing measured impact.
Experience leading technical work across multiple codebases, teams, and organizations.
Experience building and maintaining ML infrastructure for evaluation, training, or deployment.
6+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, preferably in machine learning or a related field. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with LLM evaluation, LLM-as-judge, or reward modeling.
Experience with prompt optimization, agent harness development, or post-training (SFT, DPO, RLHF).
Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.
Experience with agentic systems, simulation environments, or trajectory-based data generation.
Familiarity with on-device or privacy-preserving ML.
Understanding of how training data is used in post-training and how data choices affect model behavior.
Excellent communication skills.

At Apple, we create intuitive, intelligent experiences that enrich people's lives. We are seeking a Senior Human-Centered AI Researcher to help shape the next generation of software experiences across Apple's ecosystem. In this role, you will lead research that advances our understanding of how people interact with both emerging AI capabilities and established software experiences. Working closely with engineering, design, marketing, data science, and AI/ML modeling teams, you will define research strategies, uncover user needs and expectations, and translate behavioral insights into actionable recommendations that influence product direction, design, quality and ultimately shape the end customer experience.
Our team conducts human-centered research throughout the software and AI-feature development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and expectations to evaluating early prototypes and assessing product experience quality. We combine rigorous qualitative and quantitative methods to understand how people perceive, interact with, and experience software, including intelligent and adaptive systems.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in experimental design, statistical analysis, and mixed-methods research, with the scientific judgment to select and adapt methodologies to complex product questions. You will independently lead research initiatives across multiple product areas, collaborating with cross-functional partners to identify critical research questions, establish meaningful evaluation criteria, and translate findings into actionable product recommendations.
This role requires the ability to communicate complex findings to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and executives, and directly influence product strategy and development priorities. You will also contribute to research strategy, advance methodological practices, and mentor other researchers.
Define and lead human-centered research strategies across multiple software and AI-powered experiences, identifying critical research questions and opportunities to inform product development.
Design and execute rigorous qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-methods studies, including controlled experiments, surveys, usability evaluations, interviews, longitudinal studies, and Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA).
Apply experimental design principles and appropriate statistical techniques to evaluate user behavior, perceptions, expectations, and experience quality.
Lead research throughout the software and AI-feature development lifecycle, from early user needs and expectations research through prototype evaluation, feature refinement, and product quality assessment.
Develop human-centered evaluation frameworks, experience metrics, and success criteria to assess usability, usefulness, reliability, and perceived quality of software and intelligent systems.
Partner closely with engineering, design, product marketing, data science, and AI/ML modeling teams to align research objectives with product and technical priorities, inform tradeoffs, and guide feature development.
Integrate insights from qualitative research, self-reported measures, experimental data, and behavioral telemetry to develop a comprehensive understanding of user experience.
Translate complex research findings into clear, compelling presentations and recommendations for cross-functional teams, senior leadership, and executives, directly influencing product direction and development decisions.
Provide technical and methodological leadership across multiple projects, mentoring researchers, developing scalable research approaches, and advancing research practices across the organization.
Minimum Qualifications
PhD in Cognitive Science, Experimental Psychology, Neuroscience, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field with substantial training in quantitative and qualitative research.
5+ years of relevant experience conducting human-centered research in technology or software product development.
Formal training and demonstrated expertise in experimental design, including hypothesis development, study design, sampling strategies, randomization, measurement, and interpretation of experimental results.
Strong proficiency in statistics including t-tests, analysis of variance (ANOVA), regression models, clustering techniques, factor analysis, mixed-effects models, repeated-measures analysis, or other multivariate approaches with the ability to select, apply, and interpret appropriate analyses for complex research questions.
Demonstrated expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including survey design, usability testing, Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA), diary studies, field experiments, or other longitudinal and in-situ research programs.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools and workflows across the research lifecycle, including but not limited to research design, data processing, qualitative and quantitative analysis, and synthesis of findings, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and validity.
Experience researching AI-powered products, generative AI, intelligent systems, or emerging software interaction paradigms.
Experience combining behavioral telemetry, self-reported measures, and qualitative findings to inform product decisions.
Proven ability to translate complex research findings into actionable recommendations and communicate effectively through presentations to senior leadership and executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy, navigate ambiguous research questions, and provide methodological mentorship to other researchers.

At Apple, we believe in the power of technology to enrich people's lives. Everything we build is designed to empower people, including our advertising platform. We deliver ads in a way that benefits both customers and advertisers — helping people discover content, supporting creators, and protecting and respecting everyone’s privacy.
Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV. We help developers and marketers of all sizes drive app discovery across the App Store. Our display ads on Apple News and Stocks let advertisers promote their products alongside trusted content in a brand-safe environment, while supporting publishers and journalists. Sponsorship integrations and experiences in live sports on Apple TV help advertisers connect with captivated audiences. Everything we do is with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.
The Reporting Services team is part of Apple Ads, within the Attribution, Measurement, and Reporting organization. We build and run the applications and services that give advertisers and internal Apple teams the metrics and business insights they need to understand how their campaigns perform. Our work covers both the reporting user interface that advertisers use every day and the public Reporting APIs that power customer dashboards, third-party tools, and partner integrations. These APIs carry most of our traffic and serve a high volume of queries every second, so scalability, low latency, and reliability are central to what we do.
As a member of the team, you will design and build backend services in Java, shape the reporting framework behind new reports and metrics, and work closely with product, data platform, front-end, and site reliability teams to bring new reporting capabilities to advertisers around the world. You will help improve query performance, strengthen resiliency and security, and keep our systems healthy in production. We care about clean architecture and operational excellence, and about thinking carefully about how data is presented to customers. If you enjoy solving large-scale data and API challenges in a collaborative environment, this is a great place to make an impact.

Experience crafting scalable micro services.

Proven ability to work on sophisticated problems and systems
Strong problem solving and debugging skills.
Have the ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbal, with technical and non-technical multi-functional teams.

Proficiency in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
Experience building production applications with the Spring ecosystem (e.g. Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, etc.), including proficiency in dependency injection, auto-configuration, reactive programming with WebFlux, and designing microservices using Spring-based patterns.
Experience in API design and implementation, including proficiency in RESTful API principles, gRPC, GraphQL, contract-first design (e.g. OpenAPI/Swagger, Protobuf, etc.), API versioning strategies, gateway patterns, rate limiting, and designing APIs for backward compatibility and long-term evolution.

Experience using relational (e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, etc.) and NoSQL (e.g. Cassandra, MongoDB, etc.) databases, including proficiency in schema design, query optimization, performance tuning (e.g. execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, and query rewriting).

Track record of leading software projects within a team as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring software engineers.
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.
Comfortable using CI/CD tools to build, test, deploy, and release containerized software applications on cloud-based Kubernetes (e.g. AWS EKS, GCP GKE, Azure AKS, etc.).
Solid knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and infrastructure (e.g. HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, CDN, load balancing, edge computing, DNS, Zero Trust architecture, etc.).
Experience implementing authentication and authorization systems, including proficiency in identity protocols (e.g. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, etc.), single sign-on (SSO) architectures, role-based and attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC), and integration with identity providers and directory services.
Experience with caching strategies and in-memory data technologies (e.g. Redis, Memcached, Hazelcast, Ehcache, etc.), including proficiency in cache invalidation patterns, distributed caching architectures, and session management for high-throughput applications.

Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.
Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.
Financing & Retail Systems team is looking for an experienced Server-side Software Engineer. In this position, you will have the opportunity to partner with our extraordinary team of QA, product and external partners to deliver reliable, seamless experiences for Apple customers & Retail Store employees around the world.
As part of the team, you will be joining a hands-on backend development team that cultivates creativity and generates novel, highly scalable, secure & fault tolerant solutions to deliver engineering perfection. You'll work with engineering, QA, product, and carrier partners to solve complex problems, improve service performance and reliability, and troubleshoot issues in production. You'll also contribute to technical design discussions, review code, and help strengthen engineering practices across the team.
Design and build scalable backend services and APIs that support device activation, plan selection, pricing and order management with major carriers.
Develop, test and deploy high-quality features across the full lifecycle, from technical design through release and production support.
Integrate with carrier systems and internal Apple platforms, translating carrier requirements into reliable, well-documented solutions.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, using logs and monitoring to find root causes and prevent them from recurring.
Improve the performance, reliability and maintainability of existing services, including order, pricing and fulfillment flows.
Collaborate with product managers, QA engineers, program managers and carrier partners to define requirements and deliver on schedule.
Review code and contribute to design discussions, helping set engineering standards and mentor teammates.
Write and maintain automated tests, documentation and runbooks so services stay easy to operate and support.
Minimum Qualifications
B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience.
5+ years proven experience developing software in a professional capacity. Longer experience preferred.
2+ years proven experience with Java, including proficiency in concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization techniques.
Proficiency in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
Experience building production applications with the Spring ecosystem (e.g. Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, etc.), including proficiency in dependency injection, auto-configuration, reactive programming with WebFlux, and designing microservices using Spring-based patterns.
Experience in API design and implementation, including proficiency in RESTful API principles, gRPC, GraphQL, contract-first design (e.g. OpenAPI/Swagger, Protobuf, etc.), API versioning strategies, gateway patterns, rate limiting, and designing APIs for backward compatibility and long-term evolution.
Experience with message-driven and event-driven architectures, including proficiency in messaging systems (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.), event sourcing, CQRS patterns, and designing reliable asynchronous communication between distributed services.
Experience using relational (e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, etc.) and NoSQL (e.g. Cassandra, MongoDB, etc.) databases, including proficiency in schema design, query optimization, performance tuning (e.g. execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, and query rewriting).
Preferred Qualifications
Track record of leading software projects within a team as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring software engineers.
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.
Comfortable using CI/CD tools to build, test, deploy, and release containerized software applications on cloud-based Kubernetes (e.g. AWS EKS, GCP GKE, Azure AKS, etc.).
Solid knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and infrastructure (e.g. HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, CDN, load balancing, edge computing, DNS, Zero Trust architecture, etc.).
Experience implementing authentication and authorization systems, including proficiency in identity protocols (e.g. OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT, etc.), single sign-on (SSO) architectures, role-based and attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC), and integration with identity providers and directory services.
Experience with caching strategies and in-memory data technologies (e.g. Redis, Memcached, Hazelcast, Ehcache, etc.), including proficiency in cache invalidation patterns, distributed caching architectures, and session management for high-throughput applications.
